summary: Customers can submit product reviews with 1-5 star ratings; this requires a new API endpoint, stored review data, and schema changes for review storage, so architecture design is needed.

steps.why: Convert the ticket into structured requirements with Given/When/Then format and acceptance criteria.
steps.instructions: Focus on the review submission flow, validation rules (rating 1-5, non-empty content), duplicate prevention, and the rating recalculation mechanism.

steps.why: Design the API endpoint for review submission, database schema for reviews table, and the rating aggregation mechanism.
steps.instructions: Define POST /storefront/reviews endpoint contract, review entity schema (productId, customerId, rating, content, timestamp), aggregate rating calculation strategy, and idempotency handling for duplicate prevention.

steps.why: Break down into implementable stories: backend API, frontend form, rating display updates.
steps.instructions: Split into: (1) backend review submission endpoint with validation and rating recalculation, (2) frontend review form component with star selector and content input, (3) reviews section display updates.

steps.why: Provide file-by-file implementation plans for each story covering backend entities, controllers, services, and frontend components.
steps.instructions: Detail controller methods, service layer for validation and rating aggregation, repository interfaces, React components for review form and display, and state management.

steps.why: Map test cases to each acceptance criterion including edge cases for validation, duplicate prevention, and rating calculations.
steps.instructions: Cover boundary rating values (0, 1, 5, 6), empty/whitespace content, concurrent submission prevention, rating recalculation accuracy, and persistence after page refresh.

steps.why: Loop feature_with_architecture: Deterministic merged_plan.md from ordered specs and story summaries.
Ensure consistency between requirements, HLD API contracts, story acceptance criteria, and test coverage.
steps.instructions: Verify rating validation rules match across all documents, duplicate prevention mechanism is consistently specified, and rating calculation logic aligns in architecture and implementation stories.

steps.why: Human approval of specs and this plan before Dev.

skipped.why: The ticket clearly defines scope and acceptance criteria for review submission; no product ambiguity exists.

checks.why: This feature adds a POST /storefront/reviews endpoint, a reviews table with fields for rating and content, and updates to product rating aggregates—all are API and schema changes requiring architecture design.
